name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations | HubSpot & CRM Architecture, Lead Scoring, Lifecycle Automation, Reporting | AI-Native
summary: Marketing operations practitioner with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency roles, including 5+ years building CRM and marketing automation systems. Builds the system rather than inheriting it: lifecycle stages, lead scoring and MQL definitions, routing, nurture workflows, and data hygiene in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, synced to the CRM through Zapier, Make, n8n, and APIs. Ties campaigns to pipeline with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and enforced UTM conventions, and reports results as recommendations rather than raw numbers. Works in Salesforce from Birdeye, Wix, and Fivestars, and uses Claude and ChatGPT daily to speed up operational work, including LLM API calls in production workflows.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect CRM and marketing automation systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, defining contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, field standards, and data-hygiene protocols.

Built lead scoring, qualification criteria, and lifecycle stage definitions, and set up lead capture, tagging, and routing across 20+ automation workflows covering nurture, booking, reactivation, and post-sale onboarding.
Set up and maintain marketing automation-to-CRM syncs and data feeds into HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel using webhooks, REST APIs, and Zapier, Make, and n8n, validating every import.
Define and enforce UTM naming conventions and build GTM triggers and GA4 conversion events so campaign activity ties to measurable lead and pipeline outcomes.
Build dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, and report on a regular cadence with recommendations.
Set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, and warm-up for email programs, holding deliverability above 99%; configure cookie consent on client sites.
Call LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude) inside production workflows and use AI tools daily to draft, debug, and document operational work.

bullets: Built campaign reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering QBR-ready recommendations.
Ran ABM-style LinkedIn campaigns targeting small, researched account and contact lists with A/B-tested setups.
